summary.text: Joanne Stehr is the Republican incumbent, in office since December 1, 2022, seeking re-election to the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 107, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as nurse.

paragraphs.text: Joanne Stehr graduated from Tri-Valley High School in 1982, and her career experience includes working as a nurse.
Stehr succeeded Kurt Masser in the District 107 seat, and Ballotpedia lists her 2023-2024 committee assignments as Aging & Older Adult Services and Liquor Control.
